original: Python 3.12 PEP 688 __buffer__ and __release_buffer__ slots missing on builtins such as bytes, array, memoryview.
minimum: Relevant builtin methods must export/release useful buffers. Name existence alone insufficient.
tests: bytes, bytearray, array.array, memoryview exports: read and writable update where applicable.
Call release method and memoryview.release; verify resizing bytearray/array blocked while export exists and allowed afterward.
title: Add `__buffer__` and `__release_buffer__` methods to builtin types
